editorial:
Imagine waking up in a place you do not recognize with no memory of how you got there. You are quickly thrown into a nightmare where every corner hides something scary and the tension never lets up. The movie follows a young woman fighting for her life while trying to piece together her missing past. It feels like a wild ride from the very first scene, mixing a sense of dread with a fast-moving plot that keeps you guessing about who is actually the villain and who is the victim.

What really works here is the lead actress, who makes you feel every bit of her panic and confusion. The twists are surprising and the pacing stays tight so you never get bored. While some of the jump scares are a bit predictable, the overall energy is great for a movie night. It is a perfect pick if you want something creepy but exciting.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the girl was actually part of a secret experiment to erase memories. In the final scenes, she finds the lab where she was held and discovers she was the only survivor of the project. She manages to outsmart the lead scientist by using the same gas they used on her. She eventually escapes the building just as it burns down, finally regaining her full memory and her freedom.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves missing person mysteries and scary twists.
